questions.prompt: If Gold 2 shifts to cover the pocket from q9, what would YOU check before offering another spot?
questions.explanation: Check whether F1 can still see you and whether Gold 1 has also adjusted; re-spacing without checking both can trade one covered lane for another.

sourceChecks.scope: Fetched and read directly (WebFetch text extraction failed on the PDF binary as expected; read the saved PDF with the Read tool, pages covering the requested 'team support and transition principles'). Document is Hockey Canada's Program of Excellence U17 Technical Curriculum (internal title metadata: 'U17 Tech Curriculum - Adjustments'), an elite/selection-camp resource, NOT a U13 document. Confirmed content: defines four offensive/defensive team-play principles (Pressure, Puck Control/Stall-Contain, Support, Transition); 'Support - Offensive' states offensive players away from the puck must be available as passing options and read the puck carrier's options and intentions. This directly supports the general 'high support away from the puck' principle used in exp26-u13-021, but the source is scoped to U17 elite selection, not U13 -- flagging this age/level gap per the assignment's instruction to flag (not necessarily reject) an older-bracket source used as a disclosed adaptation. The scenario's own 'use' field already discloses 'not source-certified' for the exact coordinates/answers.
